entries.1b2548eff469507a: It sets its corporate philosophy as "Let us be the behind-the-scenes supporter of energy" and upholds "energy saving for people, renewable energy for everyone" as its base concept. Centered on the manufacture and sale of renewable energy electricity from woody biomass power generation fueled by domestically produced wood chips, it treats securing fuel stably as an important measure during the 20 years after the start of power generation in which the sales method is guaranteed under the FIT and FIP schemes. In addition, it has begun forest management, aiming to secure profitability mainly through mechanization while maintaining the cycle of planting, tending and timber production.

It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.e2c6230e03c42d7d: This business develops, builds and operates power plants that use domestically sourced woody biomass as fuel; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥13,125 million, making it the largest business. Five power plants are in operation, namely EF-ON Hita, EF-ON Shirakawa, EF-ON Bungoono, EF-ON Miyu and EF-ON Shingu, and the electricity generated is mainly sold to power companies' transmission and distribution operators. Operation of the power plants and fuel supply are handled by EF-BIOS Co., Ltd., and this business also includes the forestry business, which covers afforestation, forest cultivation and timber material production.
